M-VOICE-GATEWAY.Summary: HTTP entry point and orchestration layer for voice, text, scenario command interpretation, LLM intent routing and response generation.

M-1C-ADAPTER.Summary: Integration adapter for 1C MCP Toolkit: stock queries, vehicle and part lookup, supply source selection and document creation (ЗаказНаРемонт, ПеремещениеТоваров, ЗаказНаПеремещение, ЗаказПоставщику).

M-OBSERVABILITY.Summary: In-process timings, LM token metrics, trace aggregation and diagnostics.

M-STT.Summary: Russian speech recognition service based on faster-whisper.

M-TTS.Summary: Russian speech synthesis service based on Piper.

M-MOCK-1C.Summary: Deterministic test double for stock and order operations.

M-SCENARIO-MANAGER.Summary: Persistent business-scenario state: ScenarioFrame (fields, collections with stable item_id, dependency invalidation, focus, PendingAction), typed-command application and execution gate.

M-SCENARIO-DEFINITIONS.Summary: Declarative YAML scenario definitions (repair_order, stock_query) with strict schema validation at load time.

M-ENTITY-RESOLVER.Summary: Strict 1C entity resolution: user mention -> 1C lookup -> exact EntityRef (code/ref); ambiguous and not_found never count as filled.

M-COMMAND-INTERPRETER.Summary: Turns a user utterance into a closed set of typed commands against the ScenarioFrame (schema/focus/pending driven; stage is never the source).

M-WEB-CHAT.Summary: Browser voice/text dialogue client with VAD, cart panel and tables.

M-WEB-MONITOR.Summary: Browser monitoring UI for latency, LM token and trace metrics.

DF-VOICE-TURN.Summary: Browser audio -> STT -> gateway -> LLM intent -> 1C operation -> TTS -> browser response.

DF-PART-ORDER.Summary: Repair-order scenario over a persistent ScenarioFrame: arbitrary order of field resolution (vehicle, part rows), dependency invalidation and an explicit execution gate for 1C documents.

DF-STOCK-QUERY.Summary: Stock request (voice or text) -> gateway stock routing -> 1C adapter query (mock fallback) -> answer/tables.

DF-SCENARIO-COMMAND.Summary: Utterance -> typed command interpretation -> ScenarioManager -> ScenarioFrame mutation -> EntityResolver -> 1C -> validated response.

DF-OBSERVABILITY.Summary: Runtime timings and trace evidence from gateway to monitoring UI.
